text: Morning Renata, the Haverford production set went out to opposing counsel last night. Bates range runs 004112 through 006889. Can you check the load file before I log it in LitTrack?
Got it, thanks. Tomas said the privilege log is still missing the custodian column for the Brightwater emails.
Lunch today? I can do 12:30 at the place on Fulton, my treat since I owe you for the coffee run.
Reminder: Haverford deposition notice has to be served on all counsel of record by Friday or Dana wants a continuance motion drafted.
Dana, the conflicts check on the Oakmont trust came back clean, but the engagement letter still has the old retainer amount in section two.
Can you pull the docket sheet for Lindqvist? I need to confirm the answer deadline before I set the tickler for the reply brief.
Thanks for covering the copy machine thing yesterday, Marisol says the toner order is in and should arrive Thursday.
Please hold the Brightwater custodian files from the old archive. We have a litigation hold issued and I want the chain of custody form signed before anything moves.
Felix I added the clawback language to the stipulation. Redline is in the shared folder under Haverford, let me know if you want the second paragraph tightened up.
Quick question: do we need a certificate of service on the amended subpoena duces tecum or just the cover letter? Last time Renata wanted both.
Hi Gwen, the exhibit binder for the Lindqvist hearing is ready except tab nine. The deposition transcript excerpt never got Bates stamped, I will get it done this afternoon.
Running about ten minutes late for the 2pm witness prep, sorry. Parking on Court Street was a nightmare again.
Ilse at the clerk's office said the motion in limine hearing moved to the 14th. Updating the calendar hold and telling the team now.
Can you run ESI search terms on the Oakmont custodian list again with the new Bates prefix? Hits look too low for Teodor's mailbox.
Thanks Dana, that worked. I uploaded the signed engagement letter to Hatchwork under the Oakmont matter and closed the conflicts ticket.
Heads up the Haverford meet and confer call got pushed to Wednesday morning. Opposing paralegal wants to go over the redaction log first.
Tomas, the production cover letter still says volume two when it should be volume three. Please fix before it goes out to the vendor for imaging.
Dana asked me to pull every hot doc tagged in Relativity from the Lindqvist review batch. I have about forty so far but the tagging is inconsistent.
Happy Friday! The copier is fixed, Marisol got a tech out. Also the coffee is gone, so if you want some, you have to buy the beans.
Gwen, the subpoena to the county records office bounced back for a bad address. I will re-serve it under the registered agent instead and note the file.
Re-serving the subpoena today, process server Lou has the new address. I put the affidavit of service placeholder in the Lindqvist folder for now.
Renata, the privilege log for Haverford is done through volume three. Still need Felix to QC the entries where we withheld attorney notes on the claims adjuster emails.
Does anyone have the latest version of the local rules checklist? The one in Hatchwork is from before the judge changed the page limits.
Tomas, can you handle the Brightwater subrogation demand package? The adjuster wants the medical bills indexed by provider and date of service.
Lunch Thursday with the team? Dana says she is buying if we do the quick sandwich place, not the sushi one again.
Filed the notice of appearance on Oakmont through ECF this morning. Confirmation came back and I saved the stamped copy to the matter folder.
Dana, opposing counsel agreed to the stipulation extending the expert disclosure deadline by three weeks. I need your signature before I file it.
Note to self and anyone reading: the tickler for Lindqvist answer is set to the original date. Please update to the continuance once we get the order.
Thanks for the quick turnaround on the redaction log. I flagged two entries where the Bates numbers do not match the production load file.
Marisol, can you order more banker boxes for the Brightwater archive? We are down to four and the records vendor needs them by end of month.
Felix, the deposition summary for the foreman witness is in Hatchwork. The key admissions are on page fourteen, bookmark it before you start the brief.
Reminder that the Haverford mediation statement is due to the mediator Monday. Gwen wants the exhibit list attached with the trial binder numbering.
Sorry, I was on the phone with the client about the damages spreadsheet. Can you send me the latest version of the lost wages calculation?
Tomas says the Brightwater adjuster sent the claim file in three separate PDFs, none of them text searchable. OCR is running now, should be done by six.
Dana, the courier confirmed the originals went to the court this afternoon. Stamped copies will come back to us in the mail, so do not expect them today.
Quick check: did we ever send the litigation hold notice to the IT director for the Oakmont trust accounts? I cannot find the acknowledgment.
Gwen, the witness list for Lindqvist needs the addresses of the two former employees. Renata said do not use their home numbers, use the company contact.
Lunch is on me Friday if the Brightwater binder is finished. Hope the cafeteria has the good soup this time, last week was bad.
Sent the deficiency letter to opposing counsel on the Haverford interrogatories. They have until the end of the week to supplement or we move to compel.
Heads up, Judge Pruitt's chambers asked for courtesy copies of the summary judgment brief. I will print four sets and drop them off at the clerk window.
Dana, the stipulation was approved by the court and the new expert deadline is on the docket. Updating the tickler and the calendar hold now.
Felix, can you check the Bates prefix on the second Lindqvist production? Someone used the Haverford prefix by mistake and the vendor flagged it.
Thanks Renata. I already rebuilt the exhibit index and cross referenced it to the deposition transcripts so the cites line up.
Marisol, the Westlaw renewal invoice is in the shared inbox. Please route it to Dana for approval before the card on file gets charged.
Hi Gwen, I need your sign off on the redaction of the personnel file before I release anything to the other side. Highlights are in yellow.
Lunch today? Felix wants to try the new ramen place near the courthouse, but I think it is overpriced for what it is. Your call.
Reminder: Brightwater settlement conference is on the 19th. Tomas, please pull the demand letter, the medical summaries, and the lien notices.
Heads up that the production vendor flagged a load file error in the Oakmont batch. The DAT file has a mismatch on the custodian field, so I am re-exporting.
Dana, can you look at the clawback provision one more time? I think the non waiver language conflicts with the protective order paragraph.
Quick question for everyone, does Hatchwork still auto file the notice of appearance or do we have to upload that by hand now?
Sorry for the late reply. The Lindqvist motion to compel is sitting in my drafts folder, I need Gwen to finish the meet and confer section.
Tomas, I just finished the privilege log for the Brightwater production. Forty three entries withheld, and Renata wants the descriptions less vague.
Thanks for stopping by the office today. The shredding bin is full again, please do not leave the Oakmont drafts sitting on the printer.
Felix, the expert report for the Haverford damages came in and the numbers are off by about twelve thousand. Please check the discount rate in the model.
Gwen, the clerk confirmed the trial date is set for the spring. I am moving all the Lindqvist deadlines back in the tickler and telling the team.
Dana, I sent the engagement letter to the new client for the Mercer plumbing matter. Conflicts check is pending, so please hold off on the retainer.
Happy to help with the move Saturday. Bringing the dolly and the good tape. Let me know if the Brightwater boxes need to come along too.
Marisol, the Haverford exhibit binders are at the copy shop. Pickup is after lunch, and the tabs were misaligned on the first proof so they are redoing it.
Renata, the mediator confirmed the Haverford session for next week. I added the mediation statement and the exhibit list to the shared folder for review.
Thanks everyone for the good work this month. The Lindqvist trial prep is going to be a lot, so please flag any hot docs or Bates gaps early.
